title: 兼容备用音55

source.prompt: TrackType: SFX. One isolated original retro game interface sound for a neutral reserved compatibility cue, medium-high pitch. A soft rounded electronic square-wave blip with a stable midrange tonal body lasting eighty milliseconds and a brief smooth release. Restrained clear synthetic pulse, high duty cycle and soft edges. Immediate onset. No physical impact, no mechanical click, no woody knock, no percussion, no ringing. One blip only, no melody or musical phrase, no voices, no background. Single isolated one-shot, immediate attack and natural decay within 0.33 seconds. Then silence. No second event, no repeated sequence, no music or voice.
source.negative_prompt: music, melody, rhythm loop, vocals, speech, singing, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, clipping, long reverb, background noise, cinematic trailer, needle click, physical impact, mouse click, wooden knock, drum

editing.method: first meaningful onset, first transient, natural-decay search, bounded envelope tail

mastering.method: constant active-RMS gain with category peak ceiling
mastering.active_rms_comparison_method: 220-sample (approximately 5ms) stereo RMS windows; active=max(0.03*max_window_rms,-55dBFS), matching source baseline
mastering.basis: Preserve original relative levels: UI not louder in active RMS; ordinary impacts at most +2dB and magic +1dB; sustained textures capped at -23dBFS active RMS.

metrics.lufs_note: Integrated loudness is not meaningful for events shorter than 400ms; use active RMS and true peak.

auditory_review_note: Waveform-conditioned local audio model review completed; no human-listening claim. See audio_content_review and the linked receipt.

audio_content_review.conclusion: 现版单次提示清楚，没有证据支持替换，保留。
